electrical.note: the converter engineer's L(I) table (inductor_L_vs_I.csv) is for Kool Mu MAX; NPC 26 rolls off less (L_trip/L0 0.81 vs 0.69) - pv_tradeoff.py should read L0/L(45 A) from here
electrical.loss_note: worst-point loss 84 W against the cell budget 84 W and M1 51 W: +33 W per inductor = 98 W per PV-P75 (0.13 % of 75 kW at the 1000 V / D 0.5 / 45 A point), 130 W per PV-P100/110; loss_limit_W = hot-spot-limited value

core.asian_alternative: this is the Asian part; DMEGC DE8038 (E 80/38/20 powder E core, 26u A_L 103 nH +/-12 %, docs/datasheets/magnetics/DMEGC-DE8038.pdf) is an E-core option, but its FeSiAl loss / DC-bias curves are not retrievable (dmegc.de links return HTTP 404) -> RFQ
core.western_reference: Magnetics Kool Mu MAX 26 2 x 00Y8044E026, 38 t profiled litz 12.6 mm2, 2 layers (fits: build 17.3 of 17.8 mm): 49.9 W, hot-spot rise 71 K, ~76 USD

windings.name: L
windings.conductor: solid round enamelled Cu 3.15 mm grade 2, 1 layer
windings.arrangement: single layer, close-wound at the bore; first and last turn >= 10 mm apart with an insulating separator (up to 1000 V between them); wire class 200 (polyesterimide + polyamide-imide), grade 2

fit.note: build_m = centre hole left (>= 16 mm for clamp and air); single layer fits at the bore

insulation.system: winding-core basic: core wrapped 2 x 0.13 mm Nomex 410 + 1 x 0.05 mm polyimide over the epoxy coating (coating not counted), grade-2 enamel (not counted as insulation), VPI class H varnish (no air at the core edges); NTC in a reinforced pocket (3 layers polyimide + silicone sleeve) at the inner-side winding centre

levels.label: Basic HV-PE, switch node (TO-247 pad, magnetic cores)

insulation.routine_tests: PD-free (<= 10 pC) at 1910 V pk winding-core; AC 2200 V rms 1 s; NTC-winding AC 4400 V rms 1 s
insulation.type_tests: AC 2200 V rms 1 min winding-core, 4400 V rms NTC-winding, impulse 6 kV / 8 kV; L(I) to 72.4 A; thermal run at 83.8 W (worst-point loss of this revision) in 150 m3/h

core.formula: POCO NPC 26 catalogue fit: Pcv [mW/cm3] = k1 Bm^alpha f + k2 (Bm f)^2 with Bm [kG] = dB/2, f [kHz]; dB = V t_on / (N Ae)

winding.formula: P_cu = R_dc I_dc^2 + sum_h R(h) I_h,rms^2; R(h) Bessel skin + proximity in the single-layer field N I / (2 b), weighted along the turn (bore field N I / (2 pi r))

loss_grid.note: copper at the worst ripple; core loss vs Bm (= dB/2) at 32 kHz

thermal.basis: surface model of the cell designer (forced air, h ~25 W/m2K on the wound toroid surface); solid copper: no internal winding gradient; core gradient < 1 K
thermal.interface: in the cell air stream (150 m3/h at full load); sim/pv_module.py derates with T_air + Rth x P
thermal.thermal_limit_basis: loss at which the hot spot reaches 155 C at the module's airflow per phase and 45 C inlet (local air 55 C ASSUMED); Rth scaled from 1.073 K/W at 150 m3/h with (mass flow)^-0.6 as sim/pv_module.py

options_rejected: POCO NPF 26 (FeSi, cheapest star class): catalogue loss ~4 x NPC at 32 kHz / 0.1 T -> ~70 W core
KDM KS 26 (standard sendust, MAS data; KDM brochure is image-only): DC bias needs 42 turns (does not fit one layer), MAS core loss 51 W
POCO GPC 26 (lower loss, same cost class): no 74 mm toroid in the 2026 catalogue
single toroid (55 turns, two layers): same core loss, surface halves -> hot spot > 170 C
POCO NPX / NPA (lowest loss): 1.6-1.8 x core price
